display.title: T4: Spend the Antimatter
display.subtitle: Turn the apex output into the top catalyst
description: You built the apex reactor; now spend what it makes. Antimatter is the
hard reagent behind the pack's top crafts: the §bMythic Catalysts IV and V§r
Craft a §bMythic Catalyst V§r at the Mythic Forge to complete this quest.
Nothing puts a catalyst on gear yet: that comes with Oblivion's Rift, which
is not built. To turn antimatter into gear, upgrade a MekaSuit piece to §bMk2§r.
